---
title: "Australian lymphoma projections"
author: "Centre for Health Economics, Monash University"
format: dashboard
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false

dashboard_data = FileAttachment("data/lymphoma-dashboard-data.csv")
  .csv({typed: true})

measure_order = [
  "Incidence (cases)",
  "Incidence (age-standardised rate)",
  "Prevalence (people)"
]

diagnosis_order = [
  "total",
  "hodgkin",
  "nhl",
  "dlbcl",
  "follicular",
  "mantle_cell"
]

sex_order = ["Persons", "Females", "Males"]

measure_values = measure_order.filter(value =>
  dashboard_data.some(row => row.measure === value)
)

diagnosis_values = diagnosis_order.filter(value =>
  dashboard_data.some(row =>
    row.measure === measure && row.diagnosis_code === value
  )
)

sex_values = sex_order.filter(value =>
  dashboard_data.some(row =>
    row.measure === measure &&
    row.diagnosis_code === diagnosis_code &&
    row.sex === value
  )
)

duration_values = measure === "Prevalence (people)"
  ? [2, 3, 5, 10, 40].filter(value =>
      dashboard_data.some(row =>
        row.measure === measure &&
        row.diagnosis_code === diagnosis_code &&
        row.sex === sex &&
        row.duration_years === value
      )
    )
  : ["Not applicable"]

selected_data = dashboard_data.filter(row =>
  row.measure === measure &&
  row.diagnosis_code === diagnosis_code &&
  row.sex === sex &&
  (measure !== "Prevalence (people)" || row.duration_years === duration_years)
)

baseline = selected_data.find(row => row.year === 2021)
horizon = selected_data.find(row => row.year === 2045)

format_estimate = value => {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || Number.isNaN(value)) return "Not available"
  return measure === "Incidence (age-standardised rate)"
    ? value.toFixed(1)
    : Math.round(value).toLocaleString("en-AU")
}

change_to_horizon = baseline && horizon
  ? ((horizon.estimate / baseline.estimate) - 1) * 100
  : null

chart_title = measure === "Prevalence (people)"
  ? `${baseline?.diagnosis ?? "Selected lymphoma"}, ${duration_years}-year prevalence, ${sex.toLowerCase()}`
  : `${baseline?.diagnosis ?? "Selected lymphoma"}, ${measure.toLowerCase()}, ${sex.toLowerCase()}`

y_label = selected_data.length > 0 ? selected_data[0].unit : "Estimate"

pre_projection = selected_data.filter(row => row.period !== "Projected")
projection = selected_data.filter(row => row.period === "Projected")
projection_interval = projection.filter(row =>
  row.lower !== null && row.upper !== null
)

table_data = selected_data.map(row => ({
  Year: row.year,
  Period: row.period,
  Estimate: measure === "Incidence (age-standardised rate)"
    ? row.estimate.toFixed(1)
    : Math.round(row.estimate).toLocaleString("en-AU"),
  "Lower 95% CrI": row.lower === null
    ? ""
    : (measure === "Incidence (age-standardised rate)"
        ? row.lower.toFixed(1)
        : Math.round(row.lower).toLocaleString("en-AU")),
  "Upper 95% CrI": row.upper === null
    ? ""
    : (measure === "Incidence (age-standardised rate)"
        ? row.upper.toFixed(1)
        : Math.round(row.upper).toLocaleString("en-AU"))
}))
```

# {.sidebar}

<div class="review-badge">Draft dashboard for review</div>

Use the controls to explore the results reported by the lymphoma projections study.

```{ojs}
viewof measure = Inputs.select(measure_values, {
  value: "Incidence (cases)",
  label: "Measure"
})

viewof diagnosis_code = Inputs.select(diagnosis_values, {
  value: diagnosis_values.includes("total") ? "total" : diagnosis_values[0],
  label: "Lymphoma",
  format: value => dashboard_data.find(row => row.diagnosis_code === value)?.diagnosis ?? value
})

viewof sex = Inputs.select(sex_values, {
  value: sex_values.includes("Persons") ? "Persons" : sex_values[0],
  label: "Sex"
})

viewof duration_years = Inputs.select(duration_values, {
  value: duration_values.includes(5) ? 5 : duration_values[0],
  label: "Prevalence duration"
})
```

The three NHL subtypes are a subset of aggregate NHL and should not be added to it. Total lymphoma is HL plus aggregate NHL.

```{ojs}
html`<div class="summary-grid" role="status" aria-live="polite">
  <div class="summary-card">
    <span class="summary-label">2021 baseline</span>
    <strong>${format_estimate(baseline?.estimate)}</strong>
    <span>${y_label}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="summary-card summary-card-accent">
    <span class="summary-label">2045 projection</span>
    <strong>${format_estimate(horizon?.estimate)}</strong>
    <span>${horizon?.lower == null ? y_label : `95% CrI ${format_estimate(horizon.lower)} to ${format_estimate(horizon.upper)}`}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="summary-card">
    <span class="summary-label">Change, 2021 to 2045</span>
    <strong>${change_to_horizon == null ? "Not available" : `${change_to_horizon >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${change_to_horizon.toFixed(1)}%`}</strong>
    <span>modelled change in the selected measure</span>
  </div>
</div>`
```

### Trend to 2045

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  // Plot applies max-width: 100%, so this scales down with the dashboard
  // while avoiding Quarto's unavailable layoutWidth value.
  width: 1280,
  height: 500,
  marginLeft: 72,
  marginBottom: 52,
  title: chart_title,
  subtitle: "The shaded band is the 95% credible interval for projected results.",
  x: {
    label: "Year",
    tickFormat: "d",
    ticks: 8
  },
  y: {
    label: y_label,
    grid: true,
    zero: true,
    nice: true
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(projection_interval, {
      x: "year",
      y1: "lower",
      y2: "upper",
      fill: "#007a78",
      fillOpacity: 0.16
    }),
    Plot.lineY(pre_projection, {
      x: "year",
      y: "estimate",
      stroke: "#243447",
      strokeWidth: 2.2
    }),
    Plot.dotY(pre_projection, {
      x: "year",
      y: "estimate",
      fill: "#243447",
      r: 2.2,
      tip: true
    }),
    Plot.lineY(projection, {
      x: "year",
      y: "estimate",
      stroke: "#007a78",
      strokeWidth: 3
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([2021.5], {
      stroke: "#7a8793",
      strokeDasharray: "5,4"
    }),
    Plot.text([{year: 2022, estimate: 0, label: "Projection"}], {
      x: "year",
      y: "estimate",
      text: "label",
      dy: -12,
      textAnchor: "start",
      fill: "#52606d",
      fontSize: 12
    })
  ]
})
```

## Row {height="26%"}

::: {.card}
### Download and definitions

The complete release behind this dashboard is available as [CSV](data/lymphoma-dashboard-data.csv). Its [data dictionary](data/data-dictionary.csv) defines every column. The displayed table follows the filters in the sidebar.

Counts and prevalence are displayed as whole people. Age-standardised incidence rates are shown per 100,000 population. Downloaded values retain the underlying numerical precision.
:::

# About

## Row

::: {.card}
### What this dashboard reports

This dashboard presents Australian lymphoma incidence and prevalence estimates and projections to 2045. The headline tier contains Hodgkin lymphoma and aggregate non-Hodgkin lymphoma; together they form total lymphoma. DLBCL, follicular lymphoma and mantle cell lymphoma form a clinical decomposition of aggregate NHL and do not sum to the aggregate total.

Observed incidence ends in 2021. Prevalence for 2012–2021 is estimated using the study's modified counting method. Results from 2022 onwards are projections. Modelled uncertainty is reported using 95% credible intervals.
:::

::: {.card}
### Methods and status

Incidence was modelled using age–period–cohort models. Prevalence combined modelled incidence with observed survival and was estimated for 2-, 3-, 5-, 10- and 40-year durations. Full methods, validation and assumptions are documented in the accompanying manuscript and repository.

**Review status:** this is a draft dissemination product. It should not be described as the published version until the analysis, manuscript citation, data release and disclosure review are final.
:::

::: {.card}
### Source and citation

Source data were derived from published Australian Institute of Health and Welfare and Australian Bureau of Statistics tables. The analysis code and full reproduction instructions are available in the [Blood Cancer Projections repository](https://github.com/CHE-Monash/Blood-Cancer-Projections).

The final paper citation and archived data DOI will be added when available.
:::
